variables.name: CUSTOM_CONFIG
variables.value:
zotero:
  user_id: ${oc.env:ZOTERO_ID}
  api_key: ${oc.env:ZOTERO_KEY}
  include_path: null        # list of glob patterns, e.g. ["2026/survey/**"]; null = 整個庫
  ignore_path: null         # 要排除的 collection, e.g. ["archive/**"]

email:
  sender: ${oc.env:SENDER}
  receiver: ${oc.env:RECEIVER}
  smtp_server: smtp.qq.com  # 注意:SMTP_SERVER secret 有設時會蓋掉這裡
  smtp_port: 465            # 同上,secret 優先
  sender_password: ${oc.env:SENDER_PASSWORD}
  subject_prefix: Daily ArXiv Papers  # 信件主旨 = "<prefix> YYYY/MM/DD"

llm:
  api:
    key: ${oc.env:OPENAI_API_KEY}
    base_url: https://api.z.ai/api/coding/paas/v4
  api_mode: chat_completion     # chat_completion 或 response(OpenAI Responses API 專用)
  generation_kwargs:
    model: glm-5.3-flash
    max_tokens: 16384
    temperature: 1.0
    top_p: 0.95
    seed: 114514
    stream: true
  language: Traditional Chinese         # ← 建議改成 Traditional Chinese,否則 teaser 輸出英文
  requests_per_minute: 10   # 每分鐘 LLM 請求上限,0 = 不節流(每次呼叫至少間隔 60/rpm 秒)
  rate_limit_max_retries: 5           # 收到 429 時最多重試次數
  rate_limit_backoff_seconds: 30      # 429 後初始等待
  rate_limit_max_interval_seconds: 300  # 等待上限 / 觸發限流後的最小間隔
  summary:
    mode: teaser            # teaser / full / legacy
    teaser_char_limit: 150  # 每則速覽最大字數
    batch_size: 10          # 每個 LLM 請求帶幾篇(1 = 不批次);max_tokens 緊張就降到 6
    system_prompt: null     # 只影響 full 模式的深度導讀;null = 內建繁中 prompt

source:
  arxiv:
    category: ["cs.LG", "stat.ML", "math.OC", "cs.AI"]
    include_cross_list: false   # true = 連 cross-list 到這些類別的論文也收(量會變大)
  biorxiv:
    category: null          # 用 bioRxiv 才需要填, e.g. ["bioinformatics"]
  medrxiv:
    category: null
  chemrxiv:
    include_new_versions: false  # 是否收 chemRxiv 修訂版

reranker:
  corpus_cache_file: state/corpus_embeddings.npz  # corpus 向量快取;null = 每次重算
  local:
    model: jinaai/jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano-retrieval
    encode_kwargs:
      task: retrieval
      prompt_name: document
  api:                    # executor.reranker=api 時才會用到(走 embedding API 排序)
    key: null
    base_url: null
    model: null
    batch_size: null      # null = 64
    requests_per_minute: null
    rate_limit_max_retries: 5
    rate_limit_backoff_seconds: 30
    rate_limit_max_interval_seconds: 300

executor:
  debug: ${oc.env:DEBUG,null}
  send_empty: false       # true = 沒新論文也寄一封空信
  max_paper_num: 30      # 信中最多呈現幾篇
  source: ['arxiv']       # 可加 'biorxiv' / 'medrxiv' / 'chemrxiv'
  reranker: local         # local 或 api
  lookback_days: 3        # 往回抓幾天的論文(漏跑一次靠這個補)
  state_file: state/recommended.json  # 去重歷史;null = 關閉(會重複推薦)
  history_days: 30        # 歷史保留天數
  fulltext_paper_num: 15  # 排名前 N 篇才抓全文,其餘只用 abstract 摘要
  fulltext_workers: 4     # 平行下載全文的執行緒數
  output_dir: output      # email + run_summary artifact 輸出目錄;null = 關閉
